caption:
MY FAVORITE MAC AND CHEESE

Save this video to make the recipe soon!!! 

Pasta: 
- 150 grams Pasta - You can use macaroni, penne, fusilli or my personal favorite - farfelle
- 3 cups boiling water + 1 tsp salt

Cheese Sauce: 
- 2 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp AP flour
- 500 ml lukewarm milk
- 5 cloves of garlic
- 100 grams cheese, mix of mozarella and english cheddar
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper, freshly crushed
- 1 pinch of nutmeg powder ( SUCH AN UNDERRATED INGREDIENT) 

Breadcrumb Topping: 
- 1 tbsp melted butter
- 1/2 cup bread crumbs
( use 3 or 4 slices of bread, dried out and pulsed in a food processer)
